summary: Tested 3 independent fixes: (1) weekly study-plan retry-after-error 400 guard fix, (2) dropdown/bottom-sheet scroll fix (maxHeight->flexShrink), (3) weekly plan now costs 2 ads instead of 1. All 3 verified working end-to-end on backend + mobile-viewport frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: create_study_plan (server.py) correctly resets study_plan.blocks to a fresh single-element array on retry, not appending — this is intentional (fresh plan replaces the errored one) and works fine, just noting it for context.

generate_weekly_plan_ai max_tokens=8192 fix verified; in 2 live generation attempts during this test session, 0/2 ended in error (both succeeded first try) — no evidence of frequent failures, consistent with 'probabilistic, rare' expectation from the task note.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily mutated ania_t1@test.pl's roadmap doc in MongoDB to simulate study_plan.blocks[-1].status='error' (to test retry-after-error without waiting for a natural AI failure), then let the retry regenerate a real ready plan. Also unset study_plan entirely once to test the full create+2-ad UI flow from empty state. Final state for ania_t1@test.pl: study_plan status='ready' with 1 block, 8 weeks (regenerated by the retry test, this is real valid data, not corrupted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes for this session confirmed working: (1) POST /api/roadmap/study-plan returns 200 (not 400) when existing_blocks[-1].status=='error', and still correctly returns 400 'Plan tygodniowy już istnieje.' when status is 'pending' or 'ready' (verified via direct DB mutation + API call since a natural AI JSON failure didn't occur during testing). (2) Select.tsx bottom-sheet scroll (flexShrink:1) verified on Profile screen's 'Lokalny rynek pracy i wynagrodzenia' (6 countries, 2-line rows) and country-select screen's dropdowns, tested at both 375x667 and a tightly-constrained 320x480 viewport — all options including last one (Holandia/NL) are reachable via scroll and selectable, selection correctly updates UI and persists (PATCH flow re-confirmed). (3) WeeklyPlanTab 'Ułóż mój plan' now shows a full 2-ad flow (REKLAMA 1/2 -> thanks 'Jeszcze jedna reklama' -> Obejrzyj kolejną reklamę -> REKLAMA 2/2 -> thanks 'Dziękujemy za obejrzenie reklamy!' -> Super, kontynuuj), POST to study-plan API only fires after both ads complete (confirmed via 'Układam Twój plan...' loading state appearing only post-ad-2), and the 8-week plan rendered correctly in the UI afterward. Ad notice text correctly updated to '2 krótkie reklamy'. No bugs found in this session's 3 fixes.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no new bugs found; this was a verification pass for 3 already-implemented fixes.
